assets.name: 平整水泥 A
assets.prompt: Create ONE seamless flat ground texture tile for TidalLine, 1990s coastal pixel-art game. Authentic chunky PIXEL ART natively intended for32x32 pixels, hard square clusters, NO antialiasing. FULL-BLEED OPAQUE SQUARE, texture covers whole canvas edge to edge, no margins, no border, no frame, no isolated slab. Perfect orthographic TOP DOWN, flat diffuse light, no perspective, no bevel, no cast shadow, no vignette, no glow, no text/objects/grass/footprints. Muted restrained mid-value grey-green and grey-brown, sparse broad subtle variation, NOT dense speckled noise. All four edges must tile seamlessly, very quiet consistent outer rim with no features reaching edges. 8-12 muted colors. Smooth weathered cement in desaturated grey-green (#737D70 base,#81897B subtle lighter patches,#626C60 soft darker patches). Broad almost invisible irregular mottling, extremely sparse shallow wear. No cracks, NO tiles/grout, no pebbles, no circular marks. Average value matches subdued stone paving. Calm readable background.
assets.processing: 32px nearest sampling; 16-color quantization; A periodic 2px rim; B mean-color alignment and shared A rim
